title: Aspire Magnum Replacement Vape Pods - 2 Pods
description: Aspire Magnum Replacement Pods are engineered specifically for use with the Aspire Magnum Pod Kit. These robust, refillable pods feature a 2ml e-liquid capacity and utilise advanced integrated mesh coil technology to deliver rapid ramp-up times and intense flavour production. Designed for convenience and performance, the pods feature a user-friendly side-fill system that makes topping up your e-liquid quick and mess-free. The magnetic connection ensures a secure fit within the device, while the transparent PCTG construction allows you to easily monitor your e-liquid levels to prevent dry hits. The Magnum pods are available in two distinct resistances to suit your vaping style. The 0.25ohm pod is optimised for a loose, airy Direct-to-Lung (DTL) draw, maximising vapour production for cloud chasers. The 0.4ohm pod offers a slightly more restricted Direct-to-Lung (RDL) experience, balancing cloud density with concentrated flavour. Both options are best paired with high-VG e-liquids (70% VG or higher) to fully utilise the mesh coil's potential. Please Note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Pods, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming' simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
